title: My Cozy Simulation Adventure Game!
author: harmonicrain
selftext: Inspired by the Urbz and Sims GBA games! Worked on it for about a week right now! Just a 50 second showcase showing the day/night cycle and shadows/lighting as well as the animations, sprite work etc!

replies.author: harmonicrain
replies.body: Not coded yet - entire 20 hour quest line with NPCs with routines, factions/cliques and reputation is planned. Can't build quests without a world. Can't build a world without assets. Can't build assets without a pipeline. Takes time.

comments.author: bluerobin72
comments.body: I LOVE the urbz! This looks amazing! All of that in a week?! How did you get the design/artwork spot on? Did you buy any assets or is this all AI?

replies.author: harmonicrain
replies.body:
All AI! Here's some pictures of Claude opus's little testing area when they were working on moving from flat tiles to ones with ramps and elevated height map 😭😭🙏

After using Imagegen and failing I sent the pictures to Claude and asked to generate me some pixel art in code, kept going until an object looked perfect, and said now define these rules - don't deviate from the intended look, and make it so we can use a seed algorithm to generate alternative versions of each furniture. At 120 "objects" and over 12,000 variations of each so far! Don't get me wrong some look trash and need redoing but that's all part of the fun!

But I love the Urbz - I want the story to be just as rich and expansive for mobile - and I don't want it full of micro transactions either - I'm not in this to make money I'm in this to make a good game!

Got a 120 page story Bible ready!
